notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
